recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中大量大型異型組織球樣細胞，細胞質豐富淡粉紅，偶見多核大細胞（空心箭頭），抹片插圖為具豐富空泡狀細胞質的大型異型細胞；CD163 瀰漫強陽性，而殘存 CD19 陽性 B 細胞稀少，符合發生於 B-ALL 後的組織球肉瘤。
features: Hypercellular marrow extensively replaced by large cells with abundant pale eosinophilic to foamy cytoplasm
Scattered large, multinucleated or bizarre atypical cells (arrowhead)
Focal residual small lymphoid/hematopoietic cells (blue arrow)
Aspirate inset: large atypical cell with irregular hyperchromatic nucleus and abundant vacuolated blue cytoplasm
IHC: diffuse strong CD163; CD19 only in scattered residual cells; P53 nuclear staining in a subset of large cells; pERK positivity in neoplastic cells
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine is hypercellular and extensively infiltrated by large atypical cells with abundant pale eosinophilic to foamy cytoplasm, including multinucleated and bizarre forms, with only small residual foci of hematopoietic and lymphoid cells. The aspirate contains large atypical cells with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei and vacuolated cytoplasm. The neoplastic cells are diffusely positive for CD163 and show pERK expression and P53 nuclear staining in a subset, whereas CD19 highlights only scattered residual B cells. In a patient with prior B-lymphoblastic leukemia, findings are consistent with histiocytic sarcoma, likely secondary (transdifferentiated); clonal relationship can be established by shared IGH rearrangement or cytogenetic abnormalities.

ddx.vs: Reactive histiocytes are cytologically bland with hemophagocytosis and lack the sheet-like replacement, marked atypia and multinucleated bizarre forms.
Relapse shows sheets of small CD19+/TdT+ blasts with scant cytoplasm, whereas here CD19 is limited to rare residual cells.
Monoblasts are smaller with fine chromatin and express CD34/CD117 or lysozyme with less abundant cytoplasm and no bizarre multinucleated cells.
ALCL hallmark cells are CD30+/ALK+ T cells and CD163 negative.

stain: H&E; Wright-Giemsa; IHC: CD163, CD19, P53, pERK
